post_rebuild_reparse.method: civds.buildings.parse_building_records() run directly against the rebuilt ROM's ARM9 image (the rebuilt image no longer matches the pinned exact-ROM profile by design, so `civds buildings summarize` correctly refuses it; this step re-verifies with the same parser used by that command)

conclusion: A guarded building patch manifest (raising Bank's production cost 60 -> 100 and rewriting its effect description) was generated from the real ROM, applied to an extracted workspace, rebuilt into a new ROM, and re-parsed - confirming exactly the two targeted fields changed, the untouched fields on the same record (prerequisite technology, requires-building mask) stayed exactly as before, and neighboring records (Spice Shop, Cathedral) were completely unaffected. This proves the building-table discovery and patch capability end to end as a real modding capability.
